research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Embark Trucks is focused on developing autonomous vehicle technology, particularly in sensor data management and vehicle control systems. They are working on sensor aggregation to streamline data from various sensors, enabling efficient vehicle operation. Their research includes systems for real-time mass estimation of tractor-trailers and methods for lane change determination when encountering vehicles on the shoulder. Additionally, they are exploring emergency vehicle interaction and merge handling based on vehicle intentions. These efforts highlight Embark's commitment to enhancing autonomous driving capabilities.

overview_description.description: Embark develops self-driving truck technology designed for freight and logistic services. Embark has compiled many firsts for automated trucks, including driving across the country, operating in rain and fog, and navigating between transfer hubs. Embark is assembling a group of engineers from companies like Tesla, Google, Audi, and NASA with a professional operations team that averages over a million miles per driver.
